# yoagent

> The agent loop for Rust: stream from 7 LLM protocols, run tools, loop until done. A loop library, not an agent: everything that changes what the loop does goes through one contract, `Extension`. For agents building on it, start with the skill: skills/yoagent/SKILL.md (which feature for which job, tips and pitfalls, what changed per version).

Book: https://yologdev.github.io/yoagent/ · API: https://docs.rs/yoagent · Source: https://github.com/yologdev/yoagent

## Start here

- [Skill: which feature for which job](skills/yoagent/SKILL.md): agent-facing map, tips, pitfalls, what changed
- [Quick start](docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): an agent with tools in a few lines
- [Installation](docs/getting-started/installation.md): features (`native`, `openapi`, `gasp`, `decision`)
- [Design philosophy](docs/design-philosophy.md): what belongs in yoagent and what does not

## Concepts

- [The agent loop](docs/concepts/agent-loop.md): turns, steering, follow-ups, cancellation
- [Extensions](docs/concepts/extensions.md): the plug-in contract (tools, policies, notes, verifiers, events, Budget)
- [Tools](docs/concepts/tools.md): built-ins, custom tools, ToolSource
- [Sub-agents](docs/concepts/sub-agents.md): delegation, limits, shared state, spend
- [Messages and events](docs/concepts/messages-events.md): Message, AgentMessage, AgentEvent
- [Context management](docs/concepts/context-management.md): limits, compaction
- [Prompt caching](docs/concepts/prompt-caching.md)
- [Retry](docs/concepts/retry.md): backoff, ProviderRetry, retry_safe_events
- [Structured outputs](docs/concepts/structured-outputs.md)
- [Pricing](docs/concepts/pricing.md): opt-in prices, cost buckets
- [Skills](docs/concepts/skills.md): AgentSkills SKILL.md loading
- [Session trees](docs/concepts/session-trees.md)
- [Persistence](docs/concepts/persistence.md) · [GASP](docs/concepts/gasp.md) · [Telemetry](docs/concepts/telemetry.md)
- [Callbacks](docs/concepts/callbacks.md): the older hooks
- [Decision models](docs/concepts/decision-models.md): typed judgments, tool gate, input guard

## Companion crates

- [yoagent-rutis](https://github.com/yologdev/yoagent/tree/main/integrations/yoagent-rutis): plugins at runtime (Rust, TypeScript on Node or Bun, Python, Go); pi extensions and DeepSeek Harness plugins unchanged
- [Plugin compatibility](docs/evals/plugin-compatibility.md): measured, top 20 per ecosystem
- [yoagent-workers](https://github.com/yologdev/yoagent/tree/main/integrations/yoagent-workers): Cloudflare Workers bindings
